situations.title: 멸균 필드 설정
situations.tagline: I'm about to open the sterile drapes — can you confirm the case cart is complete first?
situations.brief: 멸균 포를 순서대로 펼쳐 무균 필드를 설정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm opening the sterile drapes now.
The field is set up and ready for the count.
Please keep clear of the sterile side of the table.
goals: 멸균 포를 무균 원칙에 맞게 펼친다

situations.title: 멸균 경계 인식
situations.tagline: Everything below table level is non-sterile — let's keep our hands above the field.
situations.brief: 멸균과 비멸균 경계를 구분하여 필드를 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: Anything below the tabletop is considered non-sterile.
Keep your hands above waist level and in view.
That edge of the drape is no longer sterile.

situations.title: 무균 물품 개봉
situations.tagline: I'll open these onto the field with an aseptic technique — peel the pack away from me, right?
situations.brief: 무균 방식으로 물품을 개봉해 필드에 올리세요.
keyPhrases: I'll peel the pack open away from the field.
Drop it onto the sterile field without touching the edge.
Let me flip it in so my gloves stay clear.

situations.title: 멸균 포장 무결성 확인
situations.tagline: Before I open this, let's check the package — I want to make sure the seal isn't compromised.
situations.brief: 포장 손상 여부를 확인한 뒤 물품을 사용하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me check the seal and expiration before we open it.
The package looks intact and dry.
If the seal is broken, we can't use it.

situations.title: 멸균 테이블 정돈
situations.tagline: Let me organize the back table so everything's within reach before we start.
situations.brief: 필드 위 물품을 사용 순서대로 정리하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll arrange the instruments in order of use.
The Mayo stand is set and within reach.
Everything on the field is accounted for.
goals: 필드 위 물품을 사용 순서로 정리한다

situations.title: 최대멸균장벽 착용
situations.tagline: For this central line we need maximal sterile barrier — cap, mask, sterile gown, gloves, and a full drape.
situations.brief: 중심정맥 삽입을 위해 최대멸균장벽을 갖추세요.
keyPhrases: We need maximal sterile barrier precautions for this line.
Cap, mask, sterile gown, gloves, and a full-body drape.
I'll drape the patient head to toe.

situations.title: 멸균 포장 물기 오염
situations.tagline: This wrapper has a wet spot — strike-through means it's contaminated, we can't use it.
situations.brief: 습윤된 멸균 포장은 오염으로 판단하고 교체하세요.
keyPhrases: There's a wet spot — that's strike-through contamination.
Moisture wicks bacteria through, so it's not sterile anymore.
Let's pull a fresh pack instead.

situations.title: 필드 위로 손 넘어감
situations.tagline: Your hand just passed over the open field — please don't reach across the sterile area.
situations.brief: 필드 위 경계 침범을 인지하고 즉시 알리세요.
keyPhrases: You just reached across the sterile field.
Please go around, not over the open area.
Let's re-check that section for contamination.

situations.title: 유효기간 지난 멸균품
situations.tagline: This pack's expiration date has passed — sterility isn't guaranteed, so I'm setting it aside.
situations.brief: 유효기간이 지난 멸균품은 사용을 보류하세요.
keyPhrases: The expiration date on this pack has passed.
We can't guarantee sterility, so I'll set it aside.
Let me grab an in-date replacement.

situations.title: 개봉 중 오염 의심
situations.tagline: I think my glove brushed the edge as I opened it — let's treat this as contaminated to be safe.
situations.brief: 개봉 중 오염이 의심되면 오염으로 처리하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm not sure it stayed sterile during opening.
When in doubt, we treat it as contaminated.
Let me re-open a fresh one.

situations.title: 비멸균자 필드 접근
situations.tagline: Could you step back, please? You're too close to the sterile field in street clothes.
situations.brief: 비멸균자에게 필드와 거리를 유지하도록 요청하세요.
keyPhrases: Please step back from the sterile field.
We need at least a foot of clearance from the drapes.
You can observe from over here safely.

situations.title: 멸균 가운 앞면 오염
situations.tagline: The front of your gown touched the non-sterile edge — you'll need to regown before you continue.
situations.brief: 오염된 멸균 가운 부위를 확인하고 교체하세요.
keyPhrases: The front of your gown is contaminated.
Only the front from chest to waist stays sterile.
Let me get you a fresh gown and gloves.

situations.title: 기기 이동 시 오염
situations.tagline: Let me guide the C-arm in — everyone keep the sterile cover clear so we don't break asepsis.
situations.brief: 장비 이동 시 무균을 유지하며 필드를 보호하세요.
keyPhrases: Watch the sterile drape as the C-arm moves in.
Keep the equipment cover from touching the field.
I'll guide it in slowly — hold the drape steady.

situations.title: 필드 위 물품 낙하
situations.tagline: That instrument just fell below the field — it's contaminated now, so hand me a replacement.
situations.brief: 필드 아래로 떨어진 물품은 오염으로 처리하세요.
keyPhrases: It dropped below the field — that's contaminated.
Don't pick it back up onto the sterile area.
I'll open a sterile replacement and note it in the count.

situations.title: 장시간 개방 필드
situations.tagline: This field's been open a while — the longer it's exposed, the higher the contamination risk.
situations.brief: 개방 시간이 길어진 필드의 오염 위험을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: This field has been open longer than we'd like.
Prolonged exposure raises the contamination risk.
Let's minimize traffic and cover it if there's a delay.

situations.title: 수술 중 대규모 필드 오염
situations.tagline: We have a major field contamination — stop, we need to re-drape and re-gown the whole team now.
situations.brief: 수술 중 필드 오염을 즉시 알리고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We have a major break in the sterile field.
Hold the case — we need to re-drape and re-gown.
Everyone step back until the field is re-established.

situations.title: 멸균 지표 실패 확인
situations.tagline: The sterilization indicator didn't change — this tray isn't sterile, we have to stop using it.
situations.brief: 멸균 지표 실패 기구는 즉시 사용을 중단하세요.
keyPhrases: The chemical indicator failed to change color.
This tray can't be considered sterile.
Stop using it and pull a verified set.

situations.title: 오염 후 긴급 재멸균
situations.tagline: We need this instrument back fast — can we flash-sterilize it, or do we open a new set?
situations.brief: 오염 후 긴급 재멸균 여부를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Can we immediate-use steam sterilize this one?
How fast can we turn it around?
If not, let's open a backup set now.

situations.title: 참관자 필드 오염
situations.tagline: The observer just brushed the field — I need you to step out and I'll manage the exposure.
situations.brief: 필드를 오염시킨 참관 인원을 통제하세요.
keyPhrases: The observer contaminated the field.
I need you to step back out of the sterile zone.
We'll assess and re-drape the affected area.

situations.title: 응급 중 무균 유지 압박
situations.tagline: I know we're moving fast, but we can't skip asepsis — give me one second to keep this sterile.
situations.brief: 응급 상황에서도 무균 원칙을 지켜내세요.
keyPhrases: Even in an emergency, we protect asepsis.
Give me a second to keep this field sterile.
Rushing now risks a serious infection later.

situations.title: 오염 은폐 압력 상황
situations.tagline: I saw the break in sterility and I have to report it — we can't pretend it didn't happen.
situations.brief: 오염 사실을 원칙대로 보고하고 은폐 압력에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: There was a break in sterility and I have to document it.
Patient safety comes before covering this up.
We report it and manage the risk transparently.
